data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1910 opened 2024 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 448.1m and recorded a net prior year reserve release of GBP 45.34m (gross basis), driven by favourable claims experience primarily across longer-tail and specialty classes (notably improvements on 2021 and 2022 underwriting years). The year experienced significant 2024 catastrophe activity (notably multiple US hurricanes and the Baltimore bridge allision) which increased current year claims, but the prior year reserve movement reported was an overall release. The release figure is taken from the movement in prior year provisions in the technical reserves note and is considered reliable.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development taken from 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross) in the Technical Provisions note. Claims development triangle and RITC entries exist in the notes (there is RITC activity referenced for Syndicate 6117/6136 and earlier external RITC adjustments) which can distort development patterns; therefore the movement note was used as the primary source. Some LOB-level reserve movements are not quantified in the report.
